releases.notes:
**(26.1.2)**

**Changes:**
- **Mod ID is now `more_leaf_particles`** (to be able to run on NeoForge :/)
- Added NeoForge support _(currently in alpha)_

**Dev changes:**
- **The mod namespace has been renamed from `moreLeafParticles` to `more_leaf_particles` to match the renamed mod id**
